title: At the café counter
passage: A. A cup is being handed to a customer. B. A customer is washing cups in a sink. C. A worker is carrying a chair outdoors. D. A cup has been placed beneath a table.
passageZh:
A. 一個杯子正被遞給顧客。
B. 一名顧客正在水槽洗杯子。
C. 一名工作人員正把椅子搬到戶外。
D. 一個杯子已被放到桌子下方。
